bullets.title: JPM AI Supply Forecast: GOOGL downgraded to Neutral; AMZN/ORCL retain Overweight; $595B funding gap through 2028
bullets.body: JPM downgrades Alphabet to Neutral from Overweight on tighter valuations while retaining Overweight on AMZN and ORCL; maintains Neutral META and Underweight MSFT. Forecasts $450B AI-related supply in 2027 ($225B parent issuance + $225B GPU/DC financing) with aggregate FCF negative through 2028 and a ~$595B funding gap across 2027-28. AWS guided ~40% growth; Meta seen as having clearest AI returns via advertising; ORCL thesis hinges on converting contracted demand to delivered capacity.

bullets.title: NVDA: Leadership vacuum, China chip halt, record Q4 guide of $130B; stock faded -3% despite pre-market strength
bullets.body: Nvidia reported 103% annualized revenue growth with Q4 guidance of $130B and long-term growth raised to 75%, but shares faded -3% intraday as the board publicly rejected Jensen Huang's potential return and NVDA halted approved Hopper data-center chip shipments to China under geopolitical pressure. Reports surfaced that NVDA approached ARM's CEO as a replacement candidate. The $500B Wall Street chip financing pledge remains entirely unfunded per SA sector summary.

bullets.title: MSFT Ignite bullish; BIS China chip rules widen closed-model gap; BABA may cut 20GW DC target
bullets.body: New US BIS remote-access rules hinder China's NVDA chip access in Southeast Asia, favoring US closed-source AI models per MS TMT. BABA may cut its 20GW data center target following restrictions; ByteDance paused a $480M chip loan and Moonshot canceled a $150M Indonesia DC deal. MSFT is deliberately preserving AI capacity for first-party apps/enterprise; ByteDance in advanced talks to spend ~$500M on Azure for OpenAI models.

bullets.title: AMD: Down 3% on Hunterbrook short report alleging China firmware access via IEIT Systems
bullets.body: Hunterbrook Media published a report alleging AMD has China-related security problems, highlighting Chinese server maker IEIT Systems' apparent access to new AMD firmware. Hunterbrook Capital disclosed it is short AMD and a basket of comparable securities. AMD shares reversed earlier gains to trade -3% on the report.

bullets.title: SNPS/CDNS: OpenAI/AMD GPU design win validates EDA TAM expansion; KeyBanc PT $605 on SNPS
bullets.body: OpenAI improved AMD's flagship GPU PPA by 14% using GPT-Synopsys paired with Synopsys EDA tools, the first notable reference use case for AI-EDA partnerships. KeyBanc sees SNPS at $605 (31.5x FY27E EPS vs. current 23.5x) and CDNS at $425 (51.5x 2027E FCF vs. 38x current), arguing AI enables faster iteration but cannot replace traditional EDA steps, representing TAM expansion via outcome-based agreements.

bullets.title: WSM: First comp miss in 2+ years; Pottery Barn deceleration sparks debate; stock -7.6% pre-market
bullets.body: WSM 3Q comps +5.1% (missed buyside bogey of ~5.5-6.0%), driven by West Elm +7.0% and Williams-Sonoma +6.8% but dragged by Pottery Barn +1.8% (vs. +5.1% in 2Q). Gross margin beat at 46.2% but FY26 guidance reiterated with 4Q implied below Street; notably, management omitted the customary 'mid-to-high teens operating margin' long-term language for the first time. Analyst PTs range $235-275 with KeyBanc OW at $270, UBS Neutral at $265, Citi Neutral at $275.

bullets.title: MDB upgraded to Buy at UBS, PT to $450; COHR authorizes $2B buyback; TEAM PT cut to $150
bullets.body: UBS upgrades MongoDB to Buy from Neutral, raising PT to $450 from $375. Coherent authorized a $2B share repurchase program, sending shares +8.3% pre-market. UBS also assumes Atlassian at Neutral with PT cut to $150 from $160, WDAY Neutral PT cut to $200 from $210.

bullets.title: BABA: JPM OW at $200 PT; cloud +67% YoY, AI losses near breakeven, EBITDA +167% YoY
bullets.body: JPM maintains Overweight on BABA with $200 PT after 2QFY27 results showed cloud external revenue grew 67% YoY (vs. 50% expectations) with EBITA margin expanding to 14.5%. Combined AI Labs losses narrowed to RMB1.7B from RMB8.2B QoQ, with cloud EBITA expected to exceed AI model losses for the first time in the December quarter. Adjusted EBITDA of RMB46B was up 167% YoY and 15% above consensus; non-GAAP EPS missed by 25%.

bullets.title: NFLX, BABA, IREN hit 52-week lows; NFLX -47.8% from high
bullets.body: StreetAccount flags NFLX down 47.8% from its 52-week high, BABA down 45.5%, and IREN down 68.8%, all reaching new 52-week lows on 11/19.

bullets.title: BE upgraded to Outperform at BMO (PT cut to $230); 370MW Texas project via FERC filing
bullets.body: Bloom Energy upgraded to Outperform at BMO Capital Markets, shares +6.6% pre-market, though PT was cut to $230 from $260. MS cyclicals note flagged a potential 370MW Bloom deployment in Texas via a FERC filing for the Lone Oak project, with Bloom opening a Houston office and expecting a Fremont facility in 2027.

bullets.title: MSFT TomorrowX/Ignite: best-positioned on AI cash flows; ORCL via healthcare; agentic CPU demand benefits AMD/INTC
bullets.body: KeyBanc TomorrowX takeaway: AI demand continues to exceed supply with no end in sight; MSFT especially well-positioned due to large existing cash flows to finance buildout; ORCL well-positioned via Oracle Health. Agentic computing is CPU-heavy, benefiting AMD and broader compute providers. Next two years require $3T-$5T in financing; hyperscalers have 2-3 year financing advantage via IG credit ratings.

bullets.title: COHR: $2B buyback authorization drives +8.3% pre-market surge
bullets.body: Coherent authorized a $2B share repurchase program, sending shares up 8.3% in pre-market trading per the SA pre-market summary.

bullets.title: DIS: Management upbeat on streaming/parks; 'One Disney' strategy; 13 more cruise ships by 2034
bullets.body: Citi TMT reports DIS CEO is confident in double-digit adjusted EPS growth; 'One Disney' strategy leveraging all assets with $3B cost savings to reinvest in DIS+ engagement. Management is preparing for cord-cutting moderation and planning 13 more cruise ships by 2034.

bullets.title: META: Suspends plans to issue Class C shares per Citi TMT
bullets.body: Citi TMT notes Meta suspended plans to issue Class C shares; no further financial detail provided in the item.

bullets.title: DASH: Jefferies bull lunch Dec 2; $250 PT, $5B+ EBITDA target on 4%+ incremental margins
bullets.body: Jefferies' top-ranked Internet analyst John Colantuoni remains bullish on DASH with a $250 Buy PT, arguing the company can reach $5B+ EBITDA as investment costs normalize, with CART grocery expansion representing additional upside. Key questions: Can GOV growth stay above 20%? Can EBITDA reach $5B+?

bullets.title: NXPI/AMBA: Deal speculation in 'final stages' per Betaville; AMBA +6-9% pre-market
bullets.body: Betaville commentary suggests an NXPI deal with AMBA may be in final stages, sending AMBA up 6.3-8.9% in pre-market. Earlier rumors suggested NVDA was involved as a third bidder. AMBA has been exploring a possible sale since at least June 2025.

bullets.title: HUT/WULF: Powered shells have upside from contracted asset value as NVDA interim CEO prioritizes land/power/shells
bullets.body: 22V notes powered shells HUT and WULF have upside from contracted asset value and pipeline expansion after NVDA's interim CEO called land, power, and shells the top financing priorities. TCEQ approved SPCX air permit for 35 turbines/750MW in Brownsville TX.

bullets.title: FOXA/ROKU: Newsmax sues Fox to block $22B Roku takeover on competition grounds
bullets.body: Newsmax filed suit against Fox to block its $22B takeover of Roku, alleging the deal hurts competition in ad-supported television per the ESG/sustainability summary.

bullets.title: CCL: MS raises PT to $32.50 as top pick post-Q3 beat; UBS cruise seller call Nov 20
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raised CCL's price target to $32.50 following a Q3 beat and positive channel checks, elevating it to top pick despite Q1 weakness raising the 2H27 bar. UBS is hosting a Nov 20 call with a major US cruise seller to discuss booking volumes, pricing, and promotional activity.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Gemini 4 Neon ranks #3 on Intelligence Index; competes on coding at lower cost than OpenAI
bullets.body: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, ranked #3 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 61, trailing only OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra per MS TMT and Citi TMT. Citi notes Gemini 4 Neon rivals peers on coding at lower cost and positions Google as a competitive force in the enterprise AI model race.
